title: What to buy at the pasar malam when you want to lose weight
intro: The pasar malam is a food paradise. Everything looks good, you want to buy it all. You don't need to avoid the pasar malam. Just go with a plan and pick more grilled or boiled food than fried. The calories below are estimates for one regular portion. Sizes may differ at each stall.

best.name: Ayam golek or roast chicken (quarter, skin removed)
best.why: High protein. Bring it home and eat with rice and vegetables.

best.name: Chicken satay, 5 sticks + a little peanut sauce
best.why: Grilled, not fried. Control the peanut sauce, just dip a little.

best.name: Grilled otak-otak, 4 pieces
best.why: Light, with fish protein. A nice snack.

best.name: Boiled corn, 1 cob
best.why: Has fibre and is filling. Ask for less butter.

best.name: Popiah basah, 1 roll
best.why: Lots of vegetables, not fried. A good choice for a light bite.

best.name: Cut fruit, 1 container
best.why: Watermelon, papaya, pineapple. A light and fresh dessert.

careful.name: Large crispy fried chicken, 1 piece
careful.why: The batter soaks up a lot of oil. Share it or remove some of the skin.

careful.name: Murtabak, 1 whole piece
careful.why: Lots of oil and egg. Half is enough for one meal.

careful.name: Apam balik, 1 large slice
careful.why: Butter, sugar and peanuts. Buy a small size or share with the family.

careful.name: Takoyaki, 6 pieces
careful.why: Sauce and mayo add calories. Ask for less sauce.

careful.name: Sweet air balang drink, 1 large cup
careful.why: Liquid calories. Buy three cups and it's like one meal.

hacks: Walk one round first before buying. Pick the 2-3 things you want most, not everything.
Choose grilled, boiled or steamed first: roast chicken, satay, otak-otak, corn.
Buy just the dishes and eat at home with rice and vegetables. That's a complete dinner.
Share kuih and fried food with the family. Taste everything, but a little at a time.
Ask for gravy, sauce or mayo on the side or just a little. Dip, don't pour.
drink: Bring your own bottle of plain water. If you want to buy, pick coconut water with no added sugar or teh o ais kosong (iced black tea, no sugar).

faq.q: Can I eat murtabak while on a diet?
faq.a: Yes. Eat half and keep half for tomorrow, or share it. Pair it with cucumber or acar and plain water, not a sweet drink.

faq.q: How do I avoid buying too much?
faq.a: Eat a little at home first, for example fruit or a boiled egg, so you don't go hungry. Bring a fixed amount of cash. When the money's gone, go home.
